text: Luis Sera created suppression pills to counteract Las Plagas infection and gave them to Leon Kennedy during the village investigation to slow the larvae's development.
The suppression pills worked by blocking the parasite's access to the host's central nervous system, delaying loss of free will.
Without the suppression pills, Leon Kennedy and Ashley Graham would have reached the terminal stage of plaga infection within hours.
Taking the suppression pills caused Leon Kennedy acute side effects including internal hemorrhaging and mental fatigue.
After defeating mutated Bitores Mendez, Leon Kennedy recovered an artificial glass eye containing retinal scan data needed to open the castle's iron gates.
Luis Sera obtained a pristine dominant Plaga sample and surgical blueprints needed to remove the parasites.
Leon Kennedy recovered Jack Krauser's personal military journals from the island's command center.

Using a keycard recovered from researcher Luis Sera, Leon Kennedy bypassed the Iron Maidens with Ashley Graham to access a hidden research wing containing a laboratory with a specialized laser treatment device.
The laser treatment device used targeted high-frequency radiation to destroy Las Plagas parasites inside a host's nervous system without harming the host's body.
